title: New Orleans trumpeters in Wickliffe's band
summary: Levy was the only New Orleanian at first, but Tommy Ladnier and Red Allen later played with them and pepped up the band.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: You were the only New Orleans man, then, in Whitliff's band, or what you've been telling me.
Well, you know, after one of the other boys left, we got Tommy Ladnere.
And then for a while, and I don't know where Tommy went, if he went back to New Orleans, or he went with the Creole band. And then we had Red Allen for a while.
Did these boys give a New Orleans sound to Whitliff's band?
No, but they pepped it up because they played a hot trumpet. Well, we called it a hot trumpet then. We didn't call it a jazz trumpet. We called it a hot trumpet.
